title: Proper Names and Titles of People

storyBeats.narrative: Mina opens a clue card and asks learners to notice capital letters for proper names and titles of people.

conceptRules: People names begin with capital letters.

guidedChecks.prompt: What should you check for capital letters for proper names and titles of people?
guidedChecks.answer: Capitalize names and titles when they are part of a specific person's name.

commonMistakes: Do not capitalize a family title when it is used as a common noun, as in my aunt.

vocabulary.definition: A word like Dr., Aunt, or Mayor used with a name.
